title: #436 Nature of Friendship
prompt: To what extent do you think the Internet has changed the nature of friendships?

promptSegments.text: To what extent do you think the Internet has changed the nature of friendships?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The Internet helps people connect with friends who live far away.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The Internet helps people connect with friends who live far away.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Social media makes it easy to keep in touch with many people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Social media makes it easy to keep in touch with many people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The Internet helps people keep old friendships alive by overcoming physical distance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The Internet helps people keep old friendships alive by overcoming physical distance.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Online platforms provide many ways for people to communicate, making them feel connected.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Online platforms provide many ways for people to communicate, making them feel connected.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The internet helps people maintain connections over long distances, allowing friends to stay in touch through tools like group chats, thus preventing the bond from weakening due to physical distance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The internet helps people maintain connections over long distances, allowing friends to stay in touch through tools like group chats, thus preventing the bond from weakening due to physical distance.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The internet provides opportunities to meet new people through online groups, which gather individuals with similar interests, thereby expanding one's social circles.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The internet provides opportunities to meet new people through online groups, which gather individuals with similar interests, thereby expanding one's social circles.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The Internet has not changed the core nature of friendships because the basic need for human connection remains the same.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The Internet has not changed the core nature of friendships because the basic need for human connection remains the same.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Friendships can still be deep and good even with technology because people use online tools to strengthen existing bonds.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Friendships can still be deep and good even with technology because people use online tools to strengthen existing bonds.
